lib.claims.rigid_root.doc: Boundary idealization: root fixture treated as rigid.

lib.claims.static.doc: Time derivatives dropped; loads applied quasi-statically.

lib.claims.adiabatic.doc: No heat exchange across the drawn boundary.

lib.claims.incompressible.doc: Density constant; valid roughly below Mach 0.3.

lib.claims.lumped_element.doc: Spatial gradients unresolved within the element.

lib.claims.elastic_modes.doc: Structural flexibility retained; modes exist and are computable.

lib.claims.topology_asserted.doc: Geometry core asserted its topological assumptions (spec §6.2).
